items.prompt: What should accompany a serialized financial dataset besides the payload itself?
items.modelAnswer: Name encoding/framing, schema version, units/types, source and time/availability scope, precision/rounding policy, size limits and a byte hash/revision. Do not present the hash as identity authentication.
